title: Say Hardin ya Insipan ed Kabuasan
intro: Diad saray mareen ya oras antis ya onsinag so banwa, walay ginawan plano ya sekreto. Say maaligwas a tawir so akaparaan lan anien, balet ta walay determinasyon ya iyarawi so kada bunga ed saramay mankaukolan. Diad kabuasan, amin et singa ag kabisado, tan sakey a leksion so niukit ed saray sanga ya maimpis parad amin ya mannononot.
clues: Akaawat kami na maaligwas a hardin tan insipan mi ya anien mi so amin a bunga na satan parad inkasikami.
Nansamba kamin ompaway kamin masakbay ed palbangon legan ya nanaugip ni ray mairap-bilay ya onkekerew na betang da.
Inekal mi so antokaman ya eksepsion ed samba mi tan inekal mi so kanepegan na saray mankaukolan ya ag mi ibabaga no labay nen Allah.
Pinmaway kamin manbubulong ed sakey tan sakey ya anggapoy mairap-bilay ya onloob ed hardin mi ed saman ya agew.
Inisip min sarag min tiponen so amin a bengatla tan amperen so siopaman a managtipon ya mangala na kabiangan.
Binmangon kami tan aromog mi so hardin mi ya aderal ed labi, maimpis a singa inani, tan inkuan min sikami so naandi tan manbabawi.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Saray Kaiba na Kanal
Saray Kaiba ed Hardin

Saray Totoo na Elepante
Saray Managbantay na Impierno

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Pangibagat na baka pian naresolbe so sangsangan nipaakar ed panagpatey
Angat ed sakey a propeta ya mangipelag na bato manlapud tawen
Manplaplanon man-ani ed kabuasan legan ya iiter ed saray mairap-bilay so apag da
Pansumlang ed Sabaton diad pangiyan na saray iket a panagsigay
Manggawa na dam pian nakontrol so delap parad negosyo
trial.answer: Manplaplanon man-ani ed kabuasan legan ya iiter ed saray mairap-bilay so apag da

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say sagradon lawak na Tuwa ya anengneng so apoy
Say apadiran ya tanamanan ya anien ed kabuasan
Say salming ya datal na palasyo et nalilingo ya danum
Say kiew a biong ya ginawa unong ed instruksion na Dios
Say bakal a padir ya impaalagey ed baetan na duaran palandey
location.answer: Say apadiran ya tanamanan ya anien ed kabuasan

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nagmaliw kamin ayep lapud impakasumlang mi ed Sabaton
Naugip kami ed sakey ya ungib ed loob na talon lasus tan siam a taon
Inakmon itayo na dalin na saray kayamanan parad inkamapaatagey
Say hardin mi et aderal ed loob na sanlabi tan tinaynan ya maimpis a singa labi
Nalner kami ed dayat legan min uusilan iray mananisia
outcome.answer: Say hardin mi et aderal ed loob na sanlabi tan tinaynan ya maimpis a singa labi

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
